title: Meetings
portalDescription: Request a meeting with the team and follow its status.
disabledDescription: The team has not enabled meeting requests for its clients. You can still reach them through your project discussion.
windowHint: Between {hours} h and {days} days in advance.
formDescription: Tell the team what you would like to discuss and propose a few times.
titlePlaceholder: e.g. Demo of the new dashboard
detailsPlaceholder: What would you like to discuss?
slotCount: {count, plural, one {# proposed time} other {# proposed times}}
slotCountHint: Propose {min} to {max} times; the team will confirm one.
requiredSlots: Please pick a date and time for each proposed slot.
duplicateTimes: The proposed times must be different.
slotRequired: Please choose a time to confirm.
meetingUrlHint: The team will use this link to join.
addressPlaceholder: Where should the team meet you?
cancelRequestDescription: “{title}” will be withdrawn. The team will not see it anymore.
invalidDuration: The meeting must last between {min} and {max} minutes.
teamDescription: Pick one of the proposed times to book it on the team calendar.
pendingCount: {count, plural, =0 {No pending requests} one {# pending request} other {# pending requests}}
acceptDescription: Choose a time for “{title}”. It will be added to the team calendar and the client will be notified.
declineDescription: Tell the client why this slot does not work. You can propose another slot in your message.
accepted: Meeting accepted and added to the calendar.
settingsDescription: Let clients request meetings from their portal and decide how requests are handled.
settingsEnabledDescription: When disabled, the meeting page is read-only in the client portal.
settingsAutoDeclineDescription: A request that overlaps another meeting is refused instead of being sent to the team.
settingsWindowDescription: How far ahead clients may book a meeting.
settingsNoticeDescription: The shortest delay between a request and the meeting.
settingsProviderDescription: Used to generate the join link when a request is accepted.
settingsProviderNotConnected: This app is not connected yet — meetings use the details provided by the client.
readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
